description: AbyssRpg reference product (rusty-underworld): the imported Abyss level drawn, lit and mapped, with the use channel's verbs.

controls.W/A/S/D: Walk forward / strafe left / back / strafe right (held states)
controls.E: Use what the avatar stands at (door, container, creature, floor object)
controls.Mouse: Look; hold/release the primary button to charge and swing
controls.Escape: Release the pointer into the pause menu
controls.L: Examine what the avatar stands at

reset: No in-game reset. Restart the dev host for a fresh session.
